repairAndWhy.TypeScript: Reach the tier that owns this failure and call '.log.error(identifier, data, error)' or '.log.warning(...)' for a row, or '.log.debug(message)' for a line that never becomes one.
repairAndWhy.Swift: In {{kind}} it writes to a stdout nobody reads. Log through os.Logger, so the message lands in the unified log with a subsystem, a category and a level.
